learnings: Tool errors (LLM API failures) can cause inconclusive results even when packages are safe; infrastructure reliability is critical for complete coverage
Models may initially flag intended functionality as suspicious (e.g., credential extraction in a credential-management plugin); self-correction mechanisms help identify these false positives
When multiple models have tool errors, a single complete audit from a reliable model can provide sufficient confidence for a verdict
Distinguish between upstream application behavior (what the tool does when running) and injection attacks (what executes during makepkg); the former is not a security concern for AUR packages
